description: Use this when the user wants examples of one part of a page: "dark pricing sections", "hero with a product screenshot", "testimonials". Returns homepage sections by kind, layout and visual tags, each with its own values (heading/body type, colors, buttons) and a screenshot. Each color is checked against the screenshot; a color it did not confirm is left out and named in `values.unconfirmed`, so take that part from the image. Not for whole sites (use search_designs).

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

previews.description: Attach a small screenshot of each of the first 8 results for you to look at. false = text only.

query.description: Free text over description, tags, heading, fonts and site, e.g. "serif headline", "gradient".

site.description: Only sections of this indexed site (slug, URL or brand name).

name: search_sections
title: Search page sections
